people.imagined: The pearl scales at the Nguyệt Tân market. She holds a pearl up to the light and looks at the buyer, not the pearl, through her shell spectacles, deciding who is lying. The north beds pay in round numbers and it bothers her.
people.subject: The moment: at a market counter she holds a single pearl in tweezers up between the viewer and the light, looking at the viewer through her spectacles. Face: most important, the spectacles: round lenses of polished, thin, iridescent pearl-shell in thin silver wire frames, shimmering pink-green, big and clear. A square, tanned, steady face; a wide forehead; level dark brown eyes seen through the shell lenses, magnified and pearly; straight, plain brows; a short nose; a calm, closed mouth with the corners just down; a fisher's sun lines at the eyes. Hair: black with grey threads, in a tight low bun with a pearl-headed pin. Body: broad-shouldered, still, upright behind a counter. Clothing: an undyed linen robe with a crossed collar and wide sleeves; an evening-blue sash tied at the front; a short grey sealskin shawl over the shoulders; a string of small round pearls at the wrist. Hands and objects: a pair of long bone tweezers holding a round white pearl the size of a pea, held up; before her on the counter a small brass balance with two tiny pans. Background: a blurred market stall, rows of small shell bowls, a window with white lake light. Light: soft cool lake light from the upper left on the pearl, which glints. Expression: patient, honest, weighing. A faint blue hint of water qi in the pearl's sheen.

people.imagined: Night at the pool edge. He has just filled the shell lamp, and the glow shows his bare brow ridges, since the eyebrows never grew back. He is devout and slow, and he watches a fry in the dark water to decide whether it may be fed.
people.subject: The moment: crouched at the edge of a dark pool at night, he looks up from the water with a pale lamp beside him. Face: most important, the missing eyebrows: the skin above both eyes is bare, smooth and pink-pale with only a few short thin stubble hairs, giving his face a startled, bare look. A long, narrow, pale face with sharp cheekbones; large, wide-set, dark eyes seeming larger for the bare brow; a long, thin nose; a thin, solemn mouth; a small scar on the chin. Hair: black, in a neat short tail at the nape. Body: thin, long-limbed, hunched. Clothing: an undyed linen robe with the sleeves tied back with blue cord; an evening-blue sash; over it a short grey sealskin apron, wet with splash; bare feet on dark wet planks. Hands and objects: in his right hand a little oyster-shell lamp ground paper-thin and glowing pale milky-white, held low; his left hand trailing in the water with fingers apart. Background: a black still pool, small silver fish shapes just under the surface, a faint round reflection. Light: the milky glow of the shell lamp from the lower right lighting his bare brow; a faint blue night at the left. Expression: devout, solemn, reserved. A faint blue hint of water qi at his fingertips.

people.imagined: The shore at Tuyết Lộc. He holds a piece of reindeer horn up to a pair of pilgrims and swears it is spirit-fish bone, and his hat gives a ridiculous dignity to the lie.
people.subject: The moment: on a snowy lakeshore he holds up a curved piece of pale antler to the viewer with a grin as wide as his face, as if offering a rare treasure. Face: most important, the hat: a tall furred hat of brown-and-white reindeer hide with floppy ear flaps tied under the chin, one ear flap sticking out sideways, filling the top of the frame. A round, cheerful, wind-reddened boy's face; narrow dark eyes full of nerve; thin light brows lifted; a snub nose with a drip; a big grin with a gap. Hair: black fringe sticking out beneath the hat. Body: small and wiry, shoulders puffed up with boast. Clothing: a short grey sealskin jacket worn over an undyed linen shirt, with a blue sash tied twice around; thick reindeer-fur mittens hung on a cord at the neck; boots of white fur. Hands and objects: a forked, curved, pale yellow-white piece of reindeer horn held aloft in his right hand; his left hand open, palm up, for a coin. Background: snow, a grey frozen lake edge, a dark herd of reindeer small and blurred. Light: cold white winter light from the upper left. Expression: gleeful, cheeky, a liar's confidence. A faint blue hint of water qi in the cold air.

people.imagined: The market in the early morning. Her basket, which smells of brine at all hours, carries something under a damp cloth; she sets it down very gently and keeps one hand on the lid.
people.subject: The moment: in the early market she sets a wide wicker basket down on a stone and rests her hand on its damp cloth lid, glancing sideways. Face: most important, the basket: a big round basket of pale wicker with a wet green-grey cloth over its top, beads of water dripping from it, filling the lower half of the frame, and a faint damp shine. A neat, round, pretty face; smooth pale skin; careful dark eyes; thin straight brows; a small nose; a small tight mouth. Hair: black, in two neat buns at the sides of the head, tied with blue ribbon. Body: slim, shoulders drawn in, upright and careful. She keeps her feet close together and her free elbow tucked in. Clothing: an undyed linen jacket with narrow sleeves and a crossed collar; an evening-blue sash; a small grey sealskin cape fastened with a shell button; a string of tiny shell beads at the neck. Hands and objects: her right hand pressed flat on the basket's cloth; her left holding the basket handle, which is wrapped in blue cord. Her knuckles are white around the cord-wrapped handle. Background: stone market stalls blurred, wet cobbles, a faint pearl-pink dawn. Light: soft pink-white dawn light from the upper left. Expression: a careful, small, closed look with the eyes cast sideways, the diligent watchfulness of a girl hiding something under a wet cloth; a faint blue hint of water qi lies about the damp basket.

people.imagined: The pool at dusk. She leans at the rail and murmurs, under her breath, the dead names of the fish as they come to the surface, one by one, her grandmother's name last of all.
people.subject: The moment: leaning over a wooden rail by a dark pool at dusk, her lips moving softly as she looks down at silver shapes. Face: most important, the downward gaze and moving lips: her eyes fixed on the water with tender attention, mouth half-open on a whispered name. A soft, round, pale face with a rounded chin; large, gentle, dark eyes; thin straight brows; a small nose; fine freckles across it. A line of fine, dark lashes shadows each cheek. Hair: black and long, in a single thick braid over the shoulder tied with an evening-blue ribbon, a small shell clip. Body: small, shoulders sloped, leaning on her forearms. Clothing: an undyed linen robe with wide sleeves, the cuffs wet at the edges; an evening-blue sash; a pale grey shawl of sealskin; bare feet on the planks. Hands and objects: her right hand holds a small paper-thin shell bowl of fish-feed; the left hand trails fingertips just above the water. A few fish-feed grains float where her fingertips almost touch the water. Background: dark water with a dozen small glints of silver fish, a reflected pale disc. Light: a soft pearly glow from the water on her face, dusk blue above. Expression: a tender, stubborn, humble tenderness, lips parting on a whispered name and the lashes lowered, with a faint blue hint of water qi in the ripples.

people.imagined: The shallows at night, a boat of oysters. He sits on the gunwale drumming his heels, grinning, because it is a game. He cannot be still and he nearly tells the whole story every time someone asks.
people.subject: The moment: perched on the gunwale of a small boat at night he drums his heels, grinning at the viewer with a finger half-raised to his lips as though about to share a secret. Face: most important, the grin with the raised finger: his lips parted in a conspirator's grin, a forefinger lifted halfway to his mouth, and the other hand a blur drumming on the wood. A narrow, quick, boyish face; a pointed chin; large, bright brown eyes with a gleam; thin quick brows; a short nose; a big gap-toothed grin. A smear of grey mud lies on one cheek. Hair: tousled sandy-brown hair with a cowlick. Body: wiry, slouching, restless. Clothing: a grey sealskin vest over a bare chest, open; undyed linen trousers rolled to the knee; an evening-blue sash tied in a loose bow; a cord of shells round the ankle. Hands and objects: the raised forefinger; behind him on the thwart a heap of grey oysters in a net. The oysters in the net are grey and rough, a few with tiny pale seams of nacre showing. Background: a black, still shallow with a dark shore, a faint moon-glow on a pale rim of water. Light: pale moonlight from the upper left, blue-silver. Expression: a playful, careless, generous grin with a secret nearly out, eyes bright and the lips parted around the gap in the teeth; a faint blue hint of water qi.

people.imagined: The dock after a dive. She is sure she is first and tells everyone her breath-hold, unasked, one hand on her great ribcage. The memory of a cut air-line makes her grin.
people.subject: The moment: standing on the dock just surfaced, chest out and chin up, announcing herself to the viewer. Face: most important, the barrel chest and the chin: a very deep, wide ribcage swelling her linen jacket, shoulders thrown back, the chin lifted. A broad, round, sunburnt face with a wide jaw; hard, bright, hazel eyes; thick dark brows; a short nose; a smug, tight smile; wet strands on her cheek. Water drips from her chin and the tip of her nose is red. Hair: black, wet and slicked back, a thick braid tied on top with grey cord. Body: powerful, short and thick through the chest, thick shoulders. Her ribs rise visibly with each deep breath. Clothing: a wet undyed linen jacket clinging to her, a blue sash tied tight; a short grey sealskin skirt; bare shoulders; a pearl-shell nose clip hanging round the neck on a cord. Hands and objects: one hand thumping her own chest; the other holding a coil of air-line (a hose of waxed sea-silk) looped over the forearm. Background: wet planks, pale grey lake, a white sky. Light: bright pale light from the upper left, water glitter. Expression: a boastful, tight, smug smile with a hard glint in the hazel eyes and a flash of cruelty beneath it, an impatient girl who is sure she is first; a faint blue hint of water qi.

people.imagined: The manor's high seat, a day of pearls. She laughs before she says no, and the laugh shakes the two large pearls in her ears. She is wearing what she likes, which is a pale and costly robe.
people.subject: The moment: seated broad and easy in a high chair she laughs warmly, head tipped back a little, before delivering a no. Face: most important, the earrings: one large round pearl in each ear, the size of a quail's egg, creamy white with a pink-green sheen, hanging from fine gold hooks, large and clear. A broad, handsome, strong-jawed face; a high, smooth, pale-gold forehead with fine laugh lines; dark, warm, shrewd eyes crinkled up; arched brows; a full mouth in a wide laugh; a dimple. Hair: black with a faint silver-white frost at the temples, swept up in a high, heavy coil held with a long pearl-headed pin. Body: broad, deep-chested, diver's shoulders, relaxed. Clothing: a robe of pale lake silk in pearl-white, embroidered at the hem and cuffs with a faint nacre shimmer, with a deep V collar; over it an evening-blue shawl of fine wool; a thick necklace of small grey pearls. Hands and objects: a large pearl, the size of a fist, resting on a small stand at her elbow; one broad hand open on the chair arm. Background: a high hall with pale wooden pillars and a distant lake window. Light: soft pearly light from the upper left, warm gold below. Expression: warm, shrewd, amused. A deep, faint blue-white hint of water qi on the pearls.

people.imagined: The pool on a dark night, the false moon lit. His wet hands hold the shell lantern and the fish drift up in a slow ring under it. He smells of the pool and does not mind.
people.subject: The moment: stooped over a dark pool with a large glowing shell lantern lifted before him, the water running from his hands. Face: most important, the wet hands and the lantern: both hands dripping, wrinkled like boiled cloth, clasping a lantern of oyster-shell ground thin as paper, glowing a soft milky white like a full moon, big in the frame. A thin, stooped, long face; sunken cheeks; kind, tired, pale-grey eyes; thin white brows; a long, thin nose; a gentle, loose mouth; wet beads on the chin. Water-weed clings to one brow and the skin is pale and wrinkled as if from long soaking. Hair: thin white hair, tied in a loose bun with a bit of water-weed twine. Body: thin, bent forward, narrow shoulders. Clothing: a soft, faded, undyed linen robe, sodden at the sleeves and the hem; an evening-blue sash gone nearly grey; a short grey sealskin cape dark with water. Hands and objects: a small wet dip-net coiled at his belt and a fish-bone comb pinned at his collar, both dark with water. Background: black pool with a ring of silver fish shapes rising toward the light. A low timber walkway runs beside him on piles and the far bank is lost in dark mist. Light: the milky-white lantern glow from below on his face, dark blue night above. Expression: a patient, devoted, gentle weariness, the soft eyes fixed on the rising fish; a faint blue-white hint of moon-like water qi.

people.imagined: A late night over the ledgers in the shore house. Her fingers are black with ink from the steward's books and she has chosen not to wash them. She was named for a frost that never came.
people.subject: The moment: at a desk in a lamplit room she looks up from a ledger with ink-stained hands resting on its edge. Face: most important, the ink-stained fingers: all ten fingertips and both palms stained deep blue-black with ink, held in the lamplight in the foreground. A tall woman's calm, long, even face; clear pale skin without a trace of the manor's frost; level, dark, patient eyes; straight, well-defined brows; a straight nose; a closed, composed mouth; a faint line between the brows. Fine shadows lie under her eyes from late nights and a drop of lamp-glow shows on her lower lip. Hair: plain black, parted in the middle and wound into a low knot with a plain wooden pin; no ornament. Body: tall, upright, composed, long neck. She sits very straight with the ledger squared before her. Clothing: an undyed linen robe, crossed collar, wide sleeves pushed back past the wrists; an evening-blue sash; a plain grey sealskin shawl; no pearls. Hands and objects: ink-stained hands flat on an open book of blank pages; a brush laid across it; a small black ink-stone. Background: a lamplit shore-house office, shelves of bound books, a dark window with a pearl of moon. Light: warm yellow lamp from the lower right, cool lake light from the upper left. Expression: a calm, steady, composed look with the mouth closed and the slightest ambition in the set of the jaw; a faint blue hint of water qi.

people.imagined: The shore house counting-room. He has two brushes behind one ear and the abacus of pearl beads under his thumb; his two ledgers lie side by side, and he smiles at the visitor, giving nothing.
people.subject: The moment: seated at a table he smiles politely at a visitor, his thumb resting on an abacus. Face: most important, the abacus of pearl beads and the two brushes: a small abacus whose beads are real round white pearls strung on thin gold rods, big in the foreground, and two thin ink brushes tucked behind his right ear, one over the other. A small, neat, round-faced man with a smooth pink-brown complexion; narrow, bright, careful eyes; thin arched brows; a small straight nose; a small mouth with a polite curve; a thin moustache and a point of beard. Hair: black, oiled and neat in a small topknot with a pale blue band. Body: small, plump, straight in his chair. Clothing: an undyed linen robe with a crossed collar and narrow sleeves with a pale-blue cuff band; an evening-blue sash tied in an exact bow; a grey sealskin waistcoat; a small ring on his little finger. Hands and objects: the abacus; behind it two closed bound books. Background: a tidy office with shelves of pearl jars, a window of lake light. Light: even soft white light from the upper left. Expression: polite, cautious, guarded. A faint blue hint of water qi, with a pale earth-yellow trace, in the pearls.

people.imagined: A hot noon on the pearl-bed dock, his shirt off after a dive, a drinking bowl in hand, which Mục Tiềm Uyên has told him not to do. The scar around his ribs shows. He has fished out a boy who did not come up.
people.subject: The moment: bare-chested on a wooden dock after a long dive, water streaming, he lifts a drinking bowl and grins. Face: most important, the scar: a thick rope of white scar line runs round his ribs from the back and across the front of his chest, a ridged pale cord clear against tanned skin. A rugged, square, sun-dark face; heavy brows; narrow green-grey eyes with a lazy, callous gleam; a broken nose; a wide, easy, dangerous grin; a short stubble. Water runs from his hair into his stubble and over the scar-ridged chest. Hair: black, wet, tied in a short tail with a cord. Body: broad, tall, heavily muscled across the shoulders, still dripping. Clothing: bare chested; undyed linen trousers soaked and clinging; a grey sealskin belt with a short knife sheath; an evening-blue cloth tied round the right bicep; bare feet. Hands and objects: a clay drinking bowl in his right hand, raised; a coil of air-line over his left shoulder. The bowl is rough clay with a thin chip at the rim and its water shines in the sun. Background: bright lake, a boat, white hot sky, wet dark planks. Light: bright hard noon from the upper left, water glitter. Expression: a lazy, easy, dangerous grin with the green-grey eyes half-lidded, a brave, callous man who does not mean to hurry; a faint blue-white hint of water qi in the drips.

people.imagined: The breeding pen at dawn. A fry brushes her palm, and she hums the same tune she hums every day. A fish scale is stuck to her sleeve, bright as a coin.
people.subject: The moment: kneeling at the edge of a shallow breeding pen, she holds one wet palm flat in the water and hums, looking down. Face: most important, the scale on her sleeve: a single large iridescent silver-green fish scale, the size of a coin, stuck on her left sleeve and catching the light, held in the foreground. A soft, oval, pale face; long dark lashes; down-turned gentle dark eyes; thin brows; a small nose; a small mouth caught mid-hum; a freckle on the chin. A few damp strands cling to her cheek. Hair: dark brown, loosely tied at the neck with a thread, long strands falling forward. Body: slight, bent forward, relaxed. Clothing: an undyed linen robe with wide sleeves damp to the elbows; an evening-blue sash tied loosely; a short grey sealskin apron; a string of tiny silver fish-scale charms on the wrist. Hands and objects: her right hand flat under the water; a small silver fish with a blue stripe nosing her palm; a shell bowl of feed beside her knee. A ring of small ripples spreads round her wrist. Background: a wooden pen, green-grey water, pale pink dawn, mist. Light: soft pink-white dawn from the upper left. Expression: a peaceful, tender, patient softness, lips just parted on the hum; a faint silvery blue hint of water qi in the ripples.

people.imagined: The outer gate. He holds his right hand, dry and plain, in his sleeve, and the left hand open. He wrote twice to take his sister's place; his mother tore the second letter. The wrath is quiet.
people.subject: The moment: standing at the outer gate, arms folded so that one hand disappears inside the opposite sleeve, glaring at the viewer. Face: most important, the hidden hand: the right hand drawn deep into the left sleeve with only the cuff and knuckle edge visible, and the left hand held open and bare, showing no frost. A lean, hard, handsome young face, a strong jaw; angry dark eyes with a stubborn stare; thick straight brows drawn down; a straight nose; lips pressed to a line; a muscle in the cheek. A vein stands at his temple and his nostrils are slightly flared. Hair: black, tied up tight with a blue band, no pearl. Body: lean, upright and stiff, arms folded. Clothing: a plain undyed linen jacket with a crossed collar and short sleeves of an outer disciple; a grey sealskin vest; a blue sash; a belt with a wooden practice blade. Hands and objects: the sleeve-hidden hand; the open left hand. Background: a wooden gate with a pale lake beyond, grey sky. Low reeds bend at the lakeshore and the gate's weathered planks are dark with damp. Light: cool pale light from the upper left. Expression: a quiet, restrained fury, the jaw tight and the dark eyes hard and level, an ambitious young man who has swallowed his anger; a faint thin blue hint of water qi.

people.imagined: The north beds, just surfaced, eyes red-rimmed from salt. She saw skiffs sit on the water and not come in, and she tells it plainly. The fur cuffs are her herder's grandmother's.
people.subject: The moment: bobbing at the surface beside a boat's gunwale, she hauls herself half out and looks straight at the viewer. Face: most important, the red-rimmed eyes and fur cuffs: both eyes ringed bright red from salt, and thick white reindeer-fur cuffs on her forearms resting on the gunwale. A blunt, strong, tanned face; wet black brows; stubborn dark eyes; a short nose; a firm mouth; salt crystals on the lashes; a faint flush. Hair: black, plastered wet to the head, a single thick braid streaming over her shoulder. Body: stocky, broad-shouldered, honest. Her wet shoulders are broad and rounded, her neck short, and water streams off her chin in a thin line. Clothing: a wet grey sealskin jacket with a stand collar; fur cuffs of white reindeer hide on both forearms; a blue sash soaked dark; a cord of white shell beads. Hands and objects: both forearms with fur cuffs laid on the boat's edge; a basket of oysters beside her. A string of small oyster shells lies on the gunwale beside her fur cuffs, and one of the cuffs has a dark wet tide-line two fingers wide near the wrist. Background: grey lake, mist, the pale shape of a distant skiff. Light: cold white light from the upper left. The wet fur cuffs and the droplets on her lashes catch small white highlights. Expression: A direct, honest stare with red-rimmed eyes, a firm mouth and an impatient jut of the chin, water running down her cheeks. A faint blue hint of water qi.

people.imagined: The old town's shallows at night, his pockets full of shells that click at every step. He tips a handful of oyster spat into the dead water as though planting a garden, and straightens, listening.
people.subject: The moment: standing knee deep in dark shallows at night, he tips a cupped hand of tiny young oysters into the water, then straightens to listen. Face: most important, the pockets: both jacket pockets and the front of his coat bulge with grey oyster shells, spilling a few shells at the edge. A broad, kind, stubborn face; short, thick, brown hair; calm dark eyes; thick, straight brows; a flat nose; a mouth set in a plain line; a tanned neck. Water beads on his short beard and the light shows the tired lines at his eyes. Hair: dark brown, short, a few water drops. Body: stocky, broad, grounded. Clothing: a grey sealskin coat with large pockets, undyed linen trousers rolled above the knees; an evening-blue sash; a shell-button collar. Hands and objects: a cupped palm holding tiny pale spat; a small lantern of shell on a hook at his belt giving a pale glow; the other hand held out. A few tiny oysters glisten like pale pearls in his cupped hand. Background: a black shallows and the ruined outline of a drowned stone wall, a dim moon. Light: pale moonlight from the upper left, a pearly glimmer low. Expression: a plain, stubborn, quiet attentiveness with the head tilted and the mouth set, a man who is listening for the dead water to answer; a faint blue hint of water qi with a pale earth trace.

people.imagined: The net-drying yard, a joke just told. He is laughing loudest, a beat after everyone else, with the netting needle still behind his ear and a half-mended net in his lap.
people.subject: The moment: seated on an overturned boat with a net on his knees, he throws his head back and laughs a beat late, mouth wide open. Face: most important, the open laugh and the needle: a big open-mouthed laugh showing all teeth, and a long bone net-needle tucked behind his right ear sticking out, large in the frame. A round, freckled, open face with chubby cheeks; narrow eyes screwed up with mirth; bushy brown brows; a flat wide nose; a gap in the front teeth. His cheeks shine and a dab of tar marks his chin. Hair: dark brown, thick and untidy, with a dried leaf stuck in it. Body: plump, loose, shoulders shaking. His belly shakes with the laugh, his shoulders bounce, and his bare ankles hang crossed beneath the hull. Clothing: an undyed linen shirt with the sleeves rolled above the elbow; a grey sealskin vest unlaced; a blue sash; bare feet. Hands and objects: a big tangle of grey netting on his lap; one hand slapping his knee. A grey net hangs in loops across his knees with a few open meshes showing, and the pale bone needle behind his ear is as long as a hand. Background: a yard of drying nets hanging like curtains, pale sky. Light: bright cloudy daylight from the upper left. Soft shadowless overcast light makes the damp nets glow faintly silver. A pale highlight rims the bone needle and the knuckles of his slapping hand. Expression: a gleeful, helpless, late laugh with the eyes screwed shut, the lazy generous joy of a boy who laughs loudest a beat after everyone else; a faint blue hint of water qi.

people.imagined: The boat at the north beds. She turns a coin over and over in her palm, calm, and hands the pearls up as she should; a black pearl in her first year paid her way. Now a steward pays her something else.
people.subject: The moment: seated calmly in a boat she turns a copper coin over in her open palm, looking up with a cool, level gaze. Face: most important, the coin: a bright round copper coin with a square hole, held flat on her palm in the foreground, glinting. A fine, calm, oval face; smooth pale skin with a pink flush on the cheeks; steady, narrow, dark eyes; thin brows; a small, neat nose; a closed, small, faintly curled mouth. A drop of lake water hangs on one lash. Hair: black, wound into a tight coil at the nape, a small pearl-headed pin, a damp strand at the temple. Body: slender, straight, composed. Clothing: an undyed linen jacket with narrow sleeves; a grey sealskin shawl; an evening-blue sash tied neatly; a thin cord with a black pearl at the throat. Hands and objects: the coin turning in her right hand; her left hand resting on the edge of a basket of pearl shells. Background: a pale grey lake, mist, the side of a boat. The boat's rim is dark wet wood and a wisp of mist rises from the grey water. Light: soft cool light from the upper left. Expression: a cool, level, faintly curled look with calm eyes, a girl who is greedy under her composure and has already decided whom she works for; a faint blue hint of water qi.

people.imagined: 410, founding the manor on piles over the still pool. A memorial portrait of the diver who said the moon in the lake is easier to catch: she looks up at the sky, a pearl-diver's mask pushed up on her brow.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened; a diver stands on a plank over still water, looking up toward the moon. Face: most important, the upward gaze and the moon: her face tilted toward a pale full moon disc painted faintly in the upper left, with its reflection in the water. A broad, plain, weathered, calm woman's face; wide-set patient dark eyes; thick plain brows; a short broad nose; a wide, quiet, gentle smile; salt lines at the eyes. Her cheekbones are weathered brown and her brow is deeply lined. Hair: black with grey, wet, tied back with a cord, a shell mask pushed up on the forehead. Body: stocky, broad-shouldered, solid. Clothing: a plain rough sleeveless sealskin diving vest in grey; short trousers; bare feet on a plank; a rope belt. Hands and objects: a small round oyster-shell dish held in the left hand; the right hand open, reaching up as if to catch the moon. The mask on her brow is carved shell with a leather strap, polished by use. Background: a pale, mottled, aged-silk ground, a faint pale moon and still water. Light: soft pale light from the upper left, dark vignette. Expression: a patient, content, gentle gaze up at the moon, the lips softly curved; a faint blue-white hint of water qi, softened by the fade.

people.imagined: 748, the frozen pool, the third month. A memorial portrait of the mistress who sat on the ice and kept the spirit fish alive: frost in her hair and lashes, a lotus pin of frost in her hair, her breath a plume.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened; a woman sits upright and cross-legged on a sheet of ice, still and silver with frost. Face: most important, the frost: her lashes, eyebrows and the strands of her hair coated in white rime, the whole face pale with a bluish cast, a small plume of breath at her lips. A strong, stern, handsome face with a firm jaw; closed or half-closed grey eyes; straight white-rimed brows; a straight nose; a closed mouth; skin silvery pale. Hair: black, heavily frosted white, gathered high in a coil held by a hairpin shaped like a frost lotus with five pale glassy petals. Body: upright, still, broad shoulders. Clothing: a thick robe of heavy undyed wool with a high crossed collar, rimed with frost on the shoulders; an old-style sash of blue; no jewellery. Hands and objects: both hands resting open on her knees above the ice; beneath the ice, faint dark fish shapes. Background: a pale, mottled, aged-silk ground, a hint of a frozen pool. Light: cold pale light from the upper left, dark vignette. Expression: stern, patient, unyielding. A faint blue-white hint of water qi, softened by the fade.
